simple.meaning: שֶׁמֶן (shemen) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “grease , especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 193 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, beginning at Genesis 28:18. Its contexts include offering, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֶׁמֶן (H8081).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שֶׁמֶן (shemen) / H8081 is traced through Genesis 28:18, Genesis 35:14, Exodus 25:6, Exodus 27:20 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: grease , especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness
definitions.usage: anointing, × fat (things), × fruitful, oil(-ed), ointment, olive, pine.
